description: Base preset for every repository: nightly schedule, GitHub automerge of CI-only bumps, weekly batched action digests

packageRules.description: [automerge] Merge github actions and pre-commit bumps once CI passes, including stability check
[cooldown] Lock file maintenance has no release timestamp; skip the release age or its stability check stays pending forever
[cooldown] Digests of actions pinned to a branch (e.g. pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish # release/v1) have no release timestamp, override default 'timestamp-required' to 'timestamp-optional'
[schedule] Propose github actions and pre-commit bumps every weekend (Saturday till Monday morning)
